context:
Goal: your plain "use Opus" message does what you meant, with no extra words.
Problem (goal): you said the scope must come from context: the judge reads your messages before and after the ask, and grants Opus only to the agents that work is for.
Based on (read): decision owner-override: `opus 2h` lifts the Opus refusal for every role for 2 hours; `opus builders 2h` for one role.
Based on (ruling): your pick 225 a (22:31 CST): the plain ask ships once its hole is fixed.
Departs from: main, where only the keyword sets the scope — a plain ask gets the scope its context names.

lastAnswer.note: Said: "it should just have the context to know what part needs opus agents from the messages before and after". Rewritten 22:32 CST: the scope comes from context.

options.gain: Opus goes only where you meant it, with no keyword.
options.how: The judge reads your ask with your messages before and after it, and names the work it covers, such as "the prose-governance workflow's judges". The grant covers spawns for that work only, until it ends. When the context names no work, the session asks you in one line.
options.label: Scope from context, ask when unclear
options.lose: A rare one-line ask when your words name no work.

options.how: As a, but when the context names no work, the ask acts like `opus 2h`.
options.label: Scope from context, fall back to every role
options.lose: A vague ask lifts Opus for every agent for 2 hours.

options.gain: Never asks, and never grants wider than you meant.
options.how: As a, but when the context names no work, nothing is granted and nothing is asked; the agents run their role's model.
options.label: Scope from context, grant nothing when unclear (coordinator reading)
options.lose: A vague ask quietly does nothing.

title: Your plain Opus ask: the judge reads the messages around it to know which agents run Opus. Build it that way?
why: Recommended: a. It does what you said, and a vague ask costs you one line instead of a wide grant. Meanwhile lane opus-plain-ask builds only the 225 a fix and holds the scope until you pick.
